fields.statement: A Shard set accepted by ArgentSeaShardPersistenceOptionsValidator<TShardOptions> must have a provider-name-matching nonempty ShardSetKey, at least one query definition, at least one shard, and nonempty read and write connection strings for every shard.
fields.scope: Validation performed by ArgentSeaShardPersistenceOptionsValidator<TShardOptions> for Orleans shard persistence.
